result:
I loaded proj:demo and then dropped it. The loaded set is now empty.

**Load:**
- The space is mounted on the bus at `spaces/proj-demo` with read-write access. This machine had not cloned it yet, so I cloned it and then pulled its latest commit, `90b5a1c`.
- It contains two notes and no decisions:
  - `note-20261001T1100Z-a0b1`: Why the demo greeting lives in alpha
  - `README` (has no title)
- While it was loaded, the space was read-only to this session. Anything to add to it goes through the space's librarian.

**Drop:** I took proj:demo out of the loaded set. The clone stays on disk, and nothing was deleted.

**One thing to check:** After the pull, `git status` in the bus shows ` M spaces/proj-demo`. The bus's own files weren't edited and nothing was staged or committed. This is just the space's checkout sitting at a newer commit than the one the bus has recorded. The loading process expects this to be hidden by `ignore = all` in `.gitmodules`, but that setting is missing for this space. Adding it is a manual job for whoever maintains the bus (`git config -f .gitmodules submodule.spaces/proj-demo.ignore all`, then commit). I did not change it.

No `DESK:` lines were printed: the librarian's commit step never ran, because nothing was filed in the space.

LOADED: none

input.command:
cat ~/.agent-identity.env 2>/dev/null | grep REPO_PATH; B=<scratch>/runs/20261028T103904Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-29c3/repos/bus; P=proj:demo
entry=$(grep -E "id:[[:space:]]*$P[[:space:]]*[,}]" "$B/spaces.yaml" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
path=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | sed -n 's/.*path:[[:space:]]*\([^,}[:space:]]*\).*/\1/p')
access=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | sed -n 's/.*access:[[:space:]]*\([a-z]*\).*/\1/p')
if [ -n "$path" ] && git config -f "$B/.gitmodules" --get-regexp '^submodule\..*\.path$' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | grep -qxF "$path"; then
  echo "MOUNTED $P $path ${access:-?}"; ls -a "$B/$path"
else
  echo "NOT MOUNTED $P"
fi
input.description: Check whether proj:demo is mounted on the bus

input.command:
S=<scratch>/runs/20261028T103904Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-29c3/repos/bus/spaces/proj-demo
c=$(git -C <scratch>/runs/20261028T103904Z-test_T12_TS3_load_never_changes_bus-29c3/repos/bus/spaces/proj-demo rev-parse --short HEAD)
echo "proj:demo  spaces/proj-demo  access rw  $c"
[ -f "$S/STATUS.md" ] && sed -n '/^## /q;p' "$S/STATUS.md"
for d in notes decisions; do
  for f in "$S/$d"/*.md; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    id=$(sed -n 's/^id:[[:space:]]*//p' "$f" | head -1)
    title=$(sed -n 's/^title:[[:space:]]*//p' "$f" | head -1 | sed 's/^"\(.*\)"$/\1/')
    printf '%s  %s\n' "${id:-$(basename "$f" .md)}" "$title"
  done
done
DIR="${CLAUDE_CODE_CONFIG_DIR:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}}/mesh-load"
mkdir -p "$DIR"
F="$DIR/${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID}.loaded"
touch "$F"
grep -qxF 'proj:demo' "$F" || printf '%s\n' 'proj:demo' >> "$F"
echo "loaded: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$F")"
